generalSettings.applicationTypeDescription: Define the application type. This will change parameters at the static and dynamic analysis level of the application.
generalSettings.linkedTeamDescription: Team linked to your project, you can't change it
generalSettings.projectIdDescription: Unique ID of your project, you can't change it. It can be used to identify this project or for automation with the API.
generalSettings.referenceBranchDescription: Set a reference branch to filter vulnerability statistics. When defined, only vulnerabilities from this branch will be counted in dashboards and reports.
generalSettings.referenceBranchWarning: Statistics will only include vulnerabilities from this branch.
generalSettings.unlinkFromGithubDescription: This will disconnect the GitHub repository currently linked to this project.
generalSettings.unlinkFromGitlabDescription: This will disconnect the GitLab repository currently linked to this project.
generalSettings.deleteProjectDescription: Deleting a project will erase everything.
generalSettings.deleteConfirmation: Are you sure you want to delete this project? This action is irreversible.

scanOnCommit.title: Scan on every commit
scanOnCommit.description: Automatically start a security scan each time a commit is pushed to the monitored branch of the linked repository. Turn this off to scan only on demand.
